title: Morin hydrate mitigates renal ischemia-reperfusion injury in association with modulation of TXNIP/NLRP3 inflammasome signaling and FOXO1/PGC-1alpha-mediated mitochondrial regulation.
authors: Mohanad, Marwa; El-Awdan, Sally A; Aboulhoda, Basma E; AbdAllah, Hend; Ahmed, Maha A E
one_liner_zh: 该文研究桑色素对肾缺血再灌注损伤的保护作用，仅用分子对接预测小分子与TXNIP-TRX复合物结合，核心是湿实验表型与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Kidney ischemia-reperfusion (I/R) injury is a major cause of acute kidney injury. This study assessed the renooprotective effects of morin hydrate (MH) and its association with inflammatory and mitochondrial regulatory pathways in an I/R rat model. METHODS: Molecular docking predicted the potential binding of MH with thioredoxin interacting protein (TXNIP)-thioredoxin (TRX) complex. Rats were assigned to four groups: sham, I/R, and I/R + MH (20 or 40 mg/kg). Renal function, oxidative stress markers, inflammatory mediators, apoptosis-related proteins, mitochondrial markers, and histopathology were assessed. RESULTS: Docking analysis suggested a potential interaction of MH with the TXNIP-TRX interface (DeltaG = -8.0 kcal/mol). In vivo, MH reduced I/R-induced increase in serum creatinine and blood urea nitrogen. MH restored mitochondrial-related parameters, including NADH dehydrogenase, cytochrome c oxidase subunit 2, and ATP levels, and mitigated oxidative stress, as indicated by reduced carbonyl protein levels and restored glutathione content. MH was also associated with reduced TXNIP, NOD-like receptor protein 3 (NLRP3), and proinflammatory cytokine levels. Apoptotic markers, including phosphorylated apoptosis signal-regulating kinase 1, caspase-3, and the Bax/Bcl2 ratio, were reduced. MH was associated with downregulation of Forkhead box protein O1 (FOXO1) and dynamin-related protein-1 and, upregulation of peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-gamma coactivator-1alpha (PGC-1alpha) and mitofusin-1. Histological findings supported these results. CONCLUSION: MH attenuated renal I/R injury and was associated with reduced oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis, along with improved mitochondrial-related parameters. These findings suggest that MH-mediated renoprotection is associated with coordinated changes in TXNIP/NLRP3 signaling and FOXO1/PGC-1alpha-related mitochondrial responses. Further research is necessary to elucidate the underlying mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 背景：肾脏缺血再灌注（I/R）损伤是急性肾损伤的主要原因。本研究在大鼠I/R模型中评估了桑色素水合物（MH）的肾脏保护作用及其与炎症和线粒体调控通路的相关性。方法：分子对接预测了MH与硫氧还蛋白相互作用蛋白（TXNIP）-硫氧还蛋白（TRX）复合物的潜在结合。大鼠分为四组：假手术组、I/R组以及I/R + MH（20或40 mg/kg）组。评估了肾功能、氧化应激标志物、炎症介质、凋亡相关蛋白、线粒体标志物和组织病理学。结果：对接分析提示MH与TXNIP-TRX界面存在潜在相互作用（DeltaG = -8.0 kcal/mol）。在体内，MH减轻了I/R诱导的血清肌酐和血尿素氮升高。MH恢复了线粒体相关参数，包括NADH脱氢酶、细胞色素c氧化酶亚基2和ATP水平，并减轻了氧化应激，表现为羰基蛋白水平降低和谷胱甘肽含量恢复。MH还与TXNIP、NOD样受体蛋白3（NLRP3）和促炎细胞因子水平降低相关。凋亡标志物，包括磷酸化凋亡信号调节激酶1、caspase-3和Bax/Bcl2比值，均有所降低。MH与叉头框蛋白O1（FOXO1）和动力相关蛋白-1的下调，以及过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ共激活因子-1α（PGC-1α）和线粒体融合蛋白-1的上调相关。组织学结果支持这些发现。结论：MH减轻了肾脏I/R损伤，并与氧化应激、炎症和凋亡减少以及线粒体相关参数改善相关。这些发现表明，MH介导的肾脏保护作用与TXNIP/NLRP3信号通路和FOXO1/PGC-1α相关线粒体反应的协调变化有关。需要进一步研究以阐明其潜在机制。
